What is hMPV?
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a common respiratory virus, similar to RSV or the flu. It causes mild to severe respiratory illness, particularly in children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems. #hMPV #Respira

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
What is hMPV?
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a common respiratory virus, similar to RSV or the flu. It causes mild to severe respiratory illness, particularly in children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems. #hMPV #RespiratoryHealth

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
👶 Who is at risk?

Infants & young children

Elderly individuals

People with chronic illnesses (e.g., asthma, COPD, heart disease)

Immunocompromised individuals (e.g., cancer patients, transplant recipients)
#VulnerablePopulations

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
🤧 Symptoms

Fever

Runny nose

Cough

Shortness of breath

Severe cases: Wheezing, pneumonia, bronchiolitis
#hMPVSymptoms

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
⚠️ Complications
While most recover fully, complications can include:

Severe respiratory distress

Pneumonia

Secondary bacterial infections

Hospitalization, especially in high-risk groups
#Complications

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
🛡️ How to stay safe?

Wash hands frequently

Avoid close contact with sick individuals

Clean and disinfect surfaces

Practice respiratory hygiene (cover coughs/sneezes)

Consider masks in crowded places during outbreaks
#Prevention #StaySafe

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
📚 Right knowledge saves lives!
Stay informed about emerging respiratory viruses. Early recognition & medical attention can reduce severe outcomes. Let’s spread awareness, not the virus!

#PublicHealth #hMPVInfo

nodes.author: janaxestar
nodes.text:
💡 Final thoughts
hMPV is often underdiagnosed but deserves attention, especially in high-risk groups. Stay vigilant, stay safe!
#HealthMatters #VirusAwareness
